title: I built an MT5 trading journal with an AI coach that reviews your actual trade history
author: Loose-Object-8913
selftext:
Been building a trading journal I actually wanted to use myself, and I’ve now added an AI coach.  
**Omega Journal** imports closed trades through a read-only MT5 connector, CSV or manual entry. It tracks performance, win rate, profit factor and drawdown, with space for your setup, mindset and trade notes.  
You can then ask things like:  
“What do my losing trades have in common?”  
“How do my plan-followed trades compare?”  
“What should I focus on in my weekly review?”  
The coach uses your recorded trades and notes—not signals or predictions. It can make mistakes, and missing context limits what it can conclude. The journal connector cannot place or manage trades and doesn’t need your trading password.  
I’ve also added a free MT5 Risk Guard utility, an XAUUSD position-size calculator, and a Traders Hub with economic releases and planning tools.  
[Journal & AI Coach](https://omegatradinghq.com/journal) · [Free tools](https://omegatradinghq.com/tools) · [Risk calculator](https://omegatradinghq.com/tools/xauusd-calculator) · [Traders Hub](https://omegatradinghq.com/hub)  
Full disclosure: it’s my website, and I also sell trading products there. Would genuinely appreciate feedback on the journal—what would make it useful enough for you to keep coming back?
